conventions: die_density_Gb_per_mm2 = (1/cell_area_um2)*1e6*array_efficiency*layers*bits_per_cell/1e9 (A1 convention), except A3-06-n2 and A3-10, where density is given at macro or chip level. Usable wafer area = 85% of gross. test_pkg_usd_per_GB = per-die test+package cost / GB per die (100 mm2 DRAM-like die at $1.5; 200 mm2 SRAM die at $3). Embedded-IP rows carry test_pkg=0 (cost lands in the host SoC). All [ESTIMATE] values are logged in research/assumptions/A3.md. [UNVERIFIED-training] = from training data (<= mid-2026), not re-verified because the shared web-search budget was exhausted and web hosts were blocked. Reference: incumbent DRAM cost ~$2.7/GB (A1 REF-DDR5-1b); DDR5 price today ~$14-27/GB; glut ~$10-12/GB; severe ~$3/GB (phase1/market.md).

NEO 3D X-DRAM is the 2020s capacitor-less revival (PoC Apr-2026) but uses IGZO/3D-NAND process, covered by A1-05.
